## Your task

Review the input tables before starting the analysis. You will run the analysis on the next page; its first action is to check the files automatically.

## Check the structure

- All three files exist and use tab-separated columns.
- Sample IDs are unique and match exactly between counts and metadata.
- Feature IDs are unique and match between counts and taxonomy.
- Counts are finite, nonnegative integers; every sample has a positive total.
- Group labels are present and represent the intended comparison.

## Check the dataset

Record SRR4125132 (99 counts) and SRR4125107 (182 counts). They pass the positive-total check but need investigation. Keep all 59 samples in the initial demonstration; document any later sensitivity analysis separately.

## Before continuing

Record the sample count, feature count, and group sizes you expect. The script checks file structure; you decide whether the selected samples support your question.
